verses.text: “If you hear someone put under oath to testify, and you’re a witness—you saw or know what happened—but stay quiet, you’re guilty and must answer for it. 🤐
“Or if you touch something unclean—a dead unclean animal, livestock, or a creature that crawls—and didn’t realize it at the time, you’re still unclean and guilty. ⚠️
“Or if you touch human uncleanness of any kind without realizing it, then later find out, you’re guilty. ⚠️
“Or if you make a rash oath—promising to do something good or bad—and only later realize it, you’re guilty for that oath. 🗣️
“When anyone is guilty in one of these ways, they must confess the sin. 🙏
“Then bring Yahweh a guilt offering for the sin: a female lamb or goat from the flock. The priest will make atonement for you. 🐑
“If you can’t afford a lamb, bring Yahweh two turtledoves or two young pigeons for the wrong you did—one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. 🕊️
“Bring them to the priest. He’ll offer the sin offering first, twisting off its head without fully severing it. 🕊️
“He’ll sprinkle some of its blood on the side of the altar and drain the rest at the altar’s base. This is the sin offering. 🩸
“He’ll offer the second bird as a burnt offering, following the rule. The priest will make atonement for your sin, and you’ll be forgiven. 🕊️
“If you can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, bring one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour for your sin offering. Don’t add oil or frankincense; it’s a sin offering. 🌾
“Bring it to the priest. He’ll take a handful as the memorial portion and burn it on the altar with Yahweh’s fire offerings. This is a sin offering. 🔥
“The priest will make atonement for your sin in any of these matters, and you’ll be forgiven. The rest of the flour belongs to the priest, like a grain offering.” 🙏
“If anyone unknowingly misuses something sacred to Yahweh, bring a flawless ram from the flock as a guilt offering. Its value must be set in sanctuary-shekels of silver. 🐏
“Pay back what you took from the sacred thing, add one-fifth of its value, and give it to the priest. The priest will make atonement for you with the ram, and you’ll be forgiven. 🪙
“If anyone breaks a command Yahweh said not to break, even without knowing it, they’re still guilty and must answer for it. ⚖️
“Bring a flawless ram from the flock, valued as required, to the priest as a guilt offering. The priest will make atonement for the sin you didn’t know about, and you’ll be forgiven. 🐏
“This is a guilt offering. The person is definitely guilty before Yahweh.” ⚖️
